description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40) Curfew Order under Section 16
categorisation: This gazette content is a Curfew Order issued under Section 16 of the Public Security Ordinance. It establishes a legal/regulatory framework by imposing restrictions on public movement in specified areas during a designated time period. The content involves the exercise of statutory powers to create legally binding regulations for public safety and order, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions the President by name, it does not involve government personnel changes or portfolio assignments, and the primary purpose is regulatory enforcement rather than government administration.
